config.spread_semantics: consumes stored spread_pips column; never re-derives from raw spread
config.cost_model: entry fill carries spread; stops pay 0.5 pip slippage; commission 0
config.arm_B_definition: trailing median of same-TF Wilder ATR(14) over 100 bars
config.stop_model: d_X = min(d_stored + (eff_buf_X - eff_buf_A), swing_cap*atr), unless d_stored already at cap
